newsitem.title: USA: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 105.2 Oct 11 wk.
newsitem.headline: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 105.2 Oct 11 wk.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute (ECRI) weekly Future Inflation Gauge (FIG) rose to 105.2 in the week ended October 11, up from a revised 105.0 in the previous week, ECRI said.
The insured unemployment rate fell to a seven-year low, the growth rate of real estate loans fell to a 181-week low, and the growth rate of industrial material prices was unchanged, ECRI said.
"While the gauge is not pointing to much disinflation, it is still pointing to subdued inflation in the months ahead," it said.
